description: Checks whether a person has countersigned an action that Deedglass paused for approval. Call it with the approval_id from a 'Waiting for approval' message. It waits up to wait_seconds (0 to 20, default 10) for the decision, so one call is usually enough. If it was approved, Deedglass runs the original tool call and returns its result. Nothing runs while the approval is pending.

approval_id.description: The approval id, for example apr_01j9zs4k7m2n3p5q6r7s8t9v0w

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a person's decision before answering, in seconds.

name: deedglass.check_approval
title: Check a Deedglass approval
